messages:
kai (DevEx): FYI a customer reported our Node quickstart sample failing on first request with 402 + {"error":"billing_not_enabled"}. They hit this right after org SSO signup.

kai (DevEx): Their steps: 1) org admin creates workspace via SSO, 2) adds card, 3) runs quickstart app with RWD_API_KEY. First call errors.

leah (Support): That's the new pending-billing gate. We surface a banner in Console that the admin must Accept Billing Terms. Adding a card alone doesn't flip the toggle.

omar (SDK): Right now SDK passes through the 402 verbatim. We should translate it into a friendly error with an actionable link. I'll draft text: "Billing not enabled for this workspace. Ask your org admin to accept Billing Terms in Console -> Billing, then retry. See: https://console.redwood.ai/billing"

rebecca (Accounts): We intentionally require an explicit accept for SSO-created orgs to reduce accidental charges. We can add an inline tooltip in the banner to explain why.

kai (DevEx): For quickstart docs I want an explicit callout: "If you were invited via SSO, ask your admin to Accept Billing Terms in the Console. If you see HTTP 402/billing_not_enabled, this is likely the cause." Also include a screenshot of the banner.

leah (Support): Short-term support copy: "If you are an end-user, contact your workspace admin and ask them to Accept Billing Terms at Console -> Billing. Admins can also run `rwd workspace refresh --wait-billing` to force recheck."

omar (SDK): I'll also add a client-side helper in the Node SDK quickstart: detect 402 with code billing_not_enabled and print the friendly message plus a one-liner admin CLI command. PR #3721.

ci-bot: Build queued for branch quickstart-fixes (tests: unit, lint).

rebecca (Accounts): Longer-term we could allow a developer-only sandbox with limited tokens that bypass accept-step for trial projects. Filing feature request FR-112.

kai (DevEx): Can you paste repro curl and the exact Node snippet so I can update the README?

leah (Support): Repro curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd_test_xxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

omar (SDK): Node snippet in quickstart now shows improved error text on 402. Also added retry helper for CLI flows: poll billing state up to 30s. CI build passed.

ci-bot: Build succeeded: quickstart-fixes -> mergeable.

kai (DevEx): Thanks team. I'll land the README update with screenshot and the troubleshooting blurb. This should cut down the "first call fails" tickets.

leah (Support): Ping me when docs are live and I'll reply to the reporter with the steps. :thumbsup:
